name: Monument
seo_title: Monument Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, Palmer Lake and Black Forest Too
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas around Monument, CO: the Limbach Park tree lighting, Christmas at the Ranch, the Palmer Lake Star and Yule Log Hunt, Black Forest farm lights and more.
lede: Monument lights its trees at Limbach Park on December 5, Colorado Kids Ranch runs a Christmas light walk with alpacas, and neighbors in Palmer Lake and Black Forest add a chili supper and star lighting, a Yule Log Hunt, a farm light ride and a community club tree lighting.
celebrates: The Tri-Lakes area north of Colorado Springs shares its Christmas events across Monument, Palmer Lake and Black Forest. The Town of Monument hosts its annual tree lighting at Limbach Park, where the town's page asks guests to bring food for Tri-Lakes Cares and new toys for Santa on Patrol. Palmer Lake's own calendar lists the star lighting supper and the Yule Log events at Town Hall, and the Black Forest Community Club and Forest Bend Farm cover the forest to the east. Colorado Kids Ranch on Highway 105 adds a walk-through light show.
lastyear: The Tri-Lakes holiday season has run on the same traditions for decades. Palmer Lake's calendar numbers this year's chili supper and star lighting as the 91st, and the Yule Log Potluck as the 93rd, so families have been gathering at Town Hall for generations. Monument's tree lighting is described by the town as the kickoff to the holiday season.
facts: The Palmer Lake Firefighters Association hosts the chili supper and the lighting of the star on Sundance Mountain, according to the listing in the Monument Independent. Palmer Lake Town Hall is at 28 Valley Crescent Street. Colorado Kids Ranch is at 2205 East Highway 105, and Forest Bend Farm is at 9525 Burgess Road. The Black Forest Community Club is at 12530 Black Forest Road.
trains: Monument sits on a rail corridor north of Colorado Springs, but we have not found a train event for families here in 2026, so there is no ride to list on this page. The closest heritage railways in our guides are the Pikes Peak Cog Railway in Manitou Springs and the Cripple Creek and Victor Narrow Gauge Railroad, both on the Pikes Peak side of the region.

faq: When is the Monument tree lighting?

The Town of Monument holds its annual tree lighting at Limbach Park on Saturday, December 5, 2026. Activity booths and a photo booth open at 2 pm and Santa arrives on a fire truck at 5 pm, according to the listing. The town asks guests to bring non-perishable food for Tri-Lakes Cares and new toys for Santa on Patrol.
What is the Palmer Lake Star lighting?

The Palmer Lake Firefighters Association hosts a chili supper and the lighting of the star on Sundance Mountain on November 28 at Palmer Lake Town Hall. The Monument Independent's listing says the evening includes pictures with Santa and kids' crafts.
Where can kids see Santa near Monument?
Santa lights the trees at Limbach Park on December 5, appears at Palmer Lake's chili supper on November 28, and visits the Black Forest Community Club on December 5 from 2 to 4 pm with Mrs. Claus.
Are there Christmas lights to walk through near Monument?

Colorado Kids Ranch lists a Christmas light walk on select evenings in December, and Forest Bend Farm runs a hayride through lights on many evenings. Prices are on the hosts' sites and are listed on each card.
Is there a train near Monument for Christmas?
We have not found a 2026 holiday train event in Monument. The Pikes Peak Cog Railway in Manitou Springs and the Cripple Creek and Victor Narrow Gauge Railroad have guides in our museum section.
